nodes.rationale: Displays material specifications that can be sourced; pricing and availability are confirmed by the sales team. Inventory, WMS and checkout are outside this website.
nodes.description: Displays material specifications that can be sourced; pricing and availability are confirmed by the sales team.

nodes.label: Shared multi-page experience
nodes.rationale: Home, Store, individual product URLs and Contact share branding, navigation and language while preserving standard browser links.
nodes.description: Home, Store, individual product URLs and Contact share branding, navigation and language while preserving standard browser links.

nodes.label: Persistent bilingual preference
nodes.rationale: The language cookie aligns server metadata with Indonesian or English content across navigation and refresh.
nodes.description: The language cookie aligns server metadata with Indonesian or English content across navigation and refresh.

nodes.label: Inquiry material session
nodes.rationale: SiteProvider persists validated material selections, including optional photo indexes, in sessionStorage and keeps different photos as separate inquiry items.
nodes.description: SiteProvider persists validated material selections, including optional photo indexes, in sessionStorage and keeps different photos as separate inquiry items.

nodes.label: Customer-reviewed contact drafts
nodes.rationale: The form prepares a reviewable summary and encoded WhatsApp or email link; the customer sends the message from their application.
nodes.description: The form prepares a reviewable summary and encoded WhatsApp or email link; the customer sends the message from their application.

nodes.label: Original facility media
nodes.rationale: Eleven original photographs and six silent videos provide facility documentation. Videos are selected on demand.
nodes.description: Eleven original photographs and six silent videos provide facility documentation.

nodes.label: BOSS brand identity
nodes.rationale: All deployed marks read BOSS BAHAN PVC; Bos addresses the customer. The hero seal places approval text above and five stars below.
nodes.description: All deployed marks read BOSS BAHAN PVC; Bos addresses the customer.

nodes.label: Validated contact configuration
nodes.rationale: Server-side environment validation supplies current business email and WhatsApp configuration through the shared provider.
nodes.description: Server-side environment validation supplies current business email and WhatsApp configuration through the shared provider.

nodes.label: Team-managed product editorial
nodes.rationale: Stable IDs connect the workbook catalog to a separate editorial file for slugs, units, descriptions, labels and color mappings. Reimport does not overwrite the editorial file.
nodes.description: Stable IDs connect the workbook catalog to a separate editorial file for slugs, units, descriptions, labels and color mappings.

nodes.label: Optional MP TECH labels
nodes.rationale: Fourteen explicit groups initially receive MP TECH. Empty labels render cleanly; Nafa Cover Material is excluded despite its sheet category.
nodes.description: Fourteen explicit groups initially receive MP TECH.

nodes.label: Permitted inquiry units
nodes.rationale: Automotive groups 1–9 allow roll/metre, ready-made tarpaulins use pieces, and other catalog groups use roll pending consultation.
nodes.description: Automotive groups 1–9 allow roll/metre, ready-made tarpaulins use pieces, and other catalog groups use roll pending consultation.

nodes.label: Explicit color image mapping
nodes.rationale: Exact imported color keys choose source photos or optimized generated variants. Thirty-two generated images fill missing options.
nodes.description: Exact imported color keys choose source photos or optimized generated variants.

nodes.label: Customer photo display policy
nodes.rationale: The owner requested no illustration badges on generated product photos. Generation references and prompts remain maintenance documentation.
nodes.description: The owner requested no illustration badges on generated product photos.

nodes.label: Workbook import separation
nodes.rationale: Import scripts write the base catalog and optimized assets; stable IDs preserve separate team editorial data.
nodes.description: Import scripts write the base catalog and optimized assets; stable IDs preserve separate team editorial data.

nodes.label: Rev1 feedback coverage map
nodes.rationale: All 15 feedback pages were read and mapped before website implementation. The matrix connects each requested change to scope, decisions and acceptance criteria.
nodes.description: All 15 feedback pages were read and mapped before website implementation.

nodes.label: Portfolio without WMS
nodes.rationale: The owner clarified that material availability is discussed through inquiry. Historical workbook statuses are not live inventory or guaranteed stock.
nodes.description: The owner clarified that material availability is discussed through inquiry.

nodes.label: Three-slide responsive hero
nodes.rationale: Three distinct hero contexts use the revised factory pricing, material selection and sourcing/delivery copy, with separate high-resolution original photos, three centered dots and horizontal swipe instead of automatic rotation.
nodes.description: Three distinct hero contexts use the revised factory pricing, material selection and sourcing/delivery copy, with separate high-resolution original photos, three centered dots and horizontal swipe instead of automatic rotation.

nodes.label: Contact form requirements
nodes.rationale: Name, business and material/delivery notes are required. Email is optional, but at least one contact method must be present.
nodes.description: Name, business and material/delivery notes are required.

nodes.label: Loopback Docker review
nodes.rationale: Next.js standalone runs in a non-root Docker container bound to 127.0.0.1:3036, with a health endpoint and noindex metadata.
nodes.description: Next.js standalone runs in a non-root Docker container bound to 127.0.0.1:3036, with a health endpoint and noindex metadata.

nodes.label: Portable project graph
nodes.rationale: Graphify is development tooling with a TypeScript runtime. Portable shared graph/report and offline Studio are committed; machine state and caches are ignored.
nodes.description: Graphify is development tooling with a TypeScript runtime.

nodes.label: Rev1 acceptance checks
nodes.rationale: TypeScript, production build, all 30 page routes, data rules, 32 generated asset responses and browser inquiry flows were checked.
nodes.description: TypeScript, production build, all 30 page routes, data rules, 32 generated asset responses and browser inquiry flows were checked.

nodes.label: Synchronized product previews
nodes.rationale: Product cards and detail pages use original-photo mode for Spunbond and CK Metallic. Other materials use mapped photo swatches without duplicate dropdowns or repeated gallery images; selected photo indexes carry into inquiries.
nodes.description: Product cards and detail pages use original-photo mode for Spunbond and CK Metallic.

nodes.label: Preview thumbnail maintenance
nodes.rationale: Generate 96 px WebP thumbnails after changing original photos or color mappings. Product editorial previewMode selects original galleries when additional color previews would repeat existing choices.
nodes.description: Generate 96 px WebP thumbnails after changing original photos or color mappings.
